City Departments

9
1
1
2
  1. City Clerk & Passport Office

    This office maintains public records, administers the records management program, posts the City Council agendas, prepares the minutes of City Council meetings, distributes the City Council meeting packets, updates and maintains the Star City Municipal Code and provides for general licensing.

  2. Building Department

    The Building Department is responsible for administering and enforcing the officially adopted building codes, as well as the City Unified Code and Ordinances.

  3. Mayor's Office

    Explore the Mayor’s Office in Star, including welcome messages, State of the City addresses, budget presentations, and leadership highlights from City Hall.

  4. Planning & Zoning

    The Planning & Zoning Department’s primary responsibility is to oversee and guide growth and development within the City.

  5. City Treasurer

  6. Sports & Recreation

    Sports & Recreation showcases local athletic programs, recreational facilities, and community events promoting health, fitness, and active living.

  7. Parks & Facilities

    Reserve city facilities and parks in Star, including the Riverhouse, Riverwalk Park, and Skatepark. For Hunter’s Creek Sports Complex, contact Star Recreation directly.

  8. City Council

    Meet the City Council members who govern the City of Star, serving four-year terms and working together to shape policy and guide city administration.

  9. Police

    Police are law enforcement officers responsible for maintaining public order, preventing and investigating crimes, and ensuring community safety.

  10. Code Enforcement

    Code Enforcement ensures compliance with local laws and regulations to maintain safety, health, and community standards.
